integrity: The proof separates dissociation sets according to whether the cone vertex is selected, reduces the cone-free case to weighted binary words avoiding 111, and derives coefficients by selected-block decomposition. A separate exhaustive checker tests induced degrees directly before comparing the recurrence and closed formulas.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to standard fan graphs K_1 join P_n with n at least four.
No claim is made about polynomial roots, coefficient unimodality, or other dissociation-set variants.
Finite exhaustive verification through n=17 is corroborative only; the all-n formulas follow from the proof.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed fan enumeration.
title: Dissociation polynomial and extremal coefficients of fan graphs
